title: Reactive, subjective and executive agents: How survival circuits underlie the expansion of subjective experience and felt motivation in humans and other vertebrates
title_zh: 反应型、主观型和执行型代理：生存回路如何支撑人类及其他脊椎动物主观体验与感受性动机的扩展
abstract: We review the evolution of agency in vertebrates from the Cambrian explosion to humans. Active locomotion sparked evolution of efficient decision-making in arthropods, vertebrates and later in cephalopods. Isolated neural pathways-ancient control architectures for fitness-effective action-became interconnected survival circuits: evolutionarily conserved, functionally integrated neural pathways responding to specific classes of stimuli and that compete for control, with their own set of specific responses. Computational complexity was reduced by constraining inputs, processing and outputs. We hypothesize that three evolutionary transitions deepened the subjective experience by extending the survival circuits: (i) Associative and social learning implied non-genetic information acquisition; (ii) A simulated reality where episodic-like memory and internal simulation resulted in prediction-based action-selection; (iii) Setting and executing one's own wellbeing goals based on future expectations produced a felt experience of short-term personal goals. This subjective agency in vertebrates and some arthropods and cephalopods evolved from reactive agency. Key to this transition was the mighty quadruple-subjective experience, social learning, simulation-based prediction and felt goals-paving the way for nonverbal rationality and consciousness, again reinforcing each other. The emergence of culture, social bonding and the beginning of friendship started in early vertebrates. In humans and partly in some other lineages, the mighty quadruple coevolved with language-based culture under adaptation to social games into executive agency, enhancing the capacities for friendship and sociability and the impact of personalised and conscious norms, values and purpose in the survival circuits, further strengthening the feeling of free will.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了从寒武纪大爆发到人类脊椎动物代理的进化。活跃的运动触发了节肢动物、脊椎动物及后来的头足动物中高效决策的进化。孤立的神经通路——适合性有效行为的古老控制架构——相互连接形成了生存回路：进化保守的、功能整合的神经通路，对特定刺激类别作出反应并竞争控制权，拥有各自特定的反应集。通过限制输入、处理和输出降低了计算复杂性。我们假设三个进化过渡通过延长生存回路深化了主观体验：（i）联想学习和社会学习意味着非遗传信息获取；（ii）一个模拟现实，其中情节类似记忆和内部模拟导致基于预测的行动选择；（iii）基于未来预期设定和执行自身的福祉目标，产生了对短期个人目标的感受性体验。脊椎动物以及一些节肢动物和头足动物的这种主观代理从反应性代理演化而来。关键在于强大的四重主观体验：社会学习、基于模拟的预测和感受性目标——为非语言理性和意识铺平了道路，二者相互加强。文化的出现、社会纽带和友谊的开始起源于早期脊椎动物。在人类及部分其他谱系中，强大的四重体与基于语言的文化在适应社会游戏的过程中共同进化，形成执行型代理，增强了友谊和社会性的能力，以及生存回路中个性化和有意识的规范、价值与目的的影响，进一步强化了自由意志的感觉。
